Species to be used for parental species analysis
```{r}
STR7_parents=All_STR7_sp
STR7_parents$strpop<-rep("hybrid",693)
STR7_parents$pure<-rep(FALSE,693)
samples_detailed<-read.csv("../../00_Scripts_and_Labels/00_DATA/metadata_specimensSequenced_Duke_taxonomyfixed.csv")
taxa_update<-cbind(Seq=samples_detailed$Seq,Taxa=samples_detailed$species_epithet)
STR7_parents<-merge(STR7_parents,taxa_update, by.x="Sample",by.y="Seq")
for(i in 1:693){
    if(STR7_parents[i,4]>.99){
      STR7_parents[i,13]<-"alba"
      STR7_parents[i,14]<-TRUE
    }else{
      if(STR7_parents[i,7]>.99){
        STR7_parents[i,13]<-"Qlyr_Qbic"
        STR7_parents[i,14]<-TRUE
        if(STR7_parents[i,15]=="lyrata"|STR7_parents[i,15]=="bicolor"){
         STR7_parents[i,13]<-STR7_parents[i,15]
        }
      }else{
       if(STR7_parents[i,2]>.99){
        STR7_parents[i,13]<-"Qmic_Qmon"
        STR7_parents[i,14]<-TRUE
        if(STR7_parents[i,15]=="michauxii"|STR7_parents[i,15]=="montana"){

          STR7_parents[i,13]<-STR7_parents[i,15]
          }
        }else{
            if(STR7_parents[i,5]>.99){
              STR7_parents[i,13]<-"Qste_Qmar_Qsin"
              STR7_parents[i,14]<-TRUE
              if(STR7_parents[i,15]=="stellata"|STR7_parents[i,15]=="margaretiae"|STR7_parents[i,15]=="sinuata"){
                STR7_parents[i,13]<-STR7_parents[i,15]
              }
            }else{
              if(STR7_parents[i,8]>.99){
                STR7_parents[i,13]<-"Qmue_Qpri"
                STR7_parents[i,14]<-TRUE
                if(STR7_parents[i,15]=="muehlenbergii"|STR7_parents[i,15]=="prinoides"){
                  STR7_parents[i,13]<-STR7_parents[i,15]
                }
              }else{
                if(STR7_parents[i,3]+STR7_parents[i,6]>0.99){
                  STR7_parents[i,13]<-"macrocarpa"
                  STR7_parents[i,14]<-TRUE
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }


write.csv(STR7_parents,"../../STR7_99Parents.csv")
```

##PCA with outgroup
```{r}
library(adegenet)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
cbbPalette2.5=c("orange","#332288","#44AA99","#AA4499","#DDCC77","#000000","#88CCEE","#882255","#114433","#999933","#661100","#CC6677","#888888","red","blue","pink")
snp <- fasta2genlight(file="../chr1_thin.fa")
meta<-read.csv("../../00_Scripts_and_Labels/00_METADATA/metadata_specimensSequenced_Duke_taxonomyfixed.csv")
pca <- glPca(snp, nf=10)
qbarplot(pca$eig/sum(pca$eig))
pca.dataset = as.data.frame(pca$scores)
pca.dataset$isolates = rownames(pca.dataset)
#pca.dataset$pop = as.factor(meta[match(snp$ind.names, meta$ALTERNATE.PROJECTCODE),]$Site)
pca.dataset$sppep = as.factor(meta[match(snp$ind.names, meta$Seq),]$species_epithet)
pca.dataset$state = as.factor(meta[match(snp$ind.names, meta$Seq),]$St)
#pca.dataset$region = as.factor(meta[match(snp$ind.names, meta$ALTERNATE.PROJECTCODE),]$...7)
pca.dataset$lat = as.numeric(coord_samp[match(snp$ind.names, coord_samp$Seq),]$latitude.orig)
pca.dataset$long = as.numeric(coord_samp[match(snp$ind.names, coord_samp$Seq),]$longitude.orig)
pca.dataset$P.HET = as.numeric(All_het[match(snp$ind.names, All_het$INDV),]$P.HET.)

ggplot(pca.dataset, aes(PC1, PC2,color=sppep)) +
  geom_point(size=1,alpha=.75)+
  theme_light()+
  scale_color_manual(values=cbbPalette2.5)

ggplot(pca.dataset, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_point(size=1,alpha=.75)+
  theme_light()

ggplot(pca.dataset, aes(PC3, PC4,color=sppep)) +
  geom_point(size=1,alpha=.75)+
  theme_light()+
  scale_color_manual(values=cbbPalette2.5)

ggplot(pca.dataset, aes(PC5, PC4,color=sppep)) +
  geom_point(size=1,alpha=.75)+
  theme_light()+
  scale_color_manual(values=cbbPalette2.5)

ggplot(pca.dataset, aes(PC5, PC6,color=sppep)) +
  geom_point(size=1,alpha=.75)+
  theme_light()+
  scale_color_manual(values=cbbPalette2.5)

ggplot(pca.dataset, aes(PC1, PC2,color=sppep)) +
  geom_point(size=2,alpha=1)+
  theme_light()+
  scale_color_manual(values=cbbPalette2.5)+
  xlim(10,20)+
  ylim(0,10)

ggplot(pca.dataset, aes(PC1, PC2,color=sppep)) +
  geom_point(size=2,alpha=1)+
  theme_light()+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("orange","#332288","#44AA99","#AA4499","#DDCC77","#000000","#88CCEE","#882255","#114433","#BBCC66","#661100","#CC6677","#888888"))+
  xlim(-15,-5)+
  ylim(-26,-19)

ggplot(pca.dataset, aes(PC1, PC2,color=sppep)) +
  geom_point(size=2,alpha=1)+
  theme_light()+
  scale_color_manual(values=cbbPalette2.5)+
  xlim(-16,-9)+
  ylim(-11.5,-6)
write.csv(pca.dataset,file="../../10_Analysis/04_PCA/C1_outgroup_PCA.csv")
write.csv(pca$eig,file="../../10_Analysis/04_PCA/Full_PCA_eig.csv")
```

```{r}
All_S12_dat2=All_S12_dat
All_S12_dat2$strpop<-rep("hybrid",694)
#All_S12_dat2$sp_cor<-rep(FALSE,720)
All_S12_dat2$hybrid<-rep("hybrid60",694)
for(i in 1:694){
  if(All_S12_dat2[i,9]>.90){
    All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qste_Qmar"
    All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
  }else{
    if(All_S12_dat2[i,10]>.90){
      All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qalb"
      All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
    }else{
      if(All_S12_dat2[i,6]>.90){
        All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qlyr_Qbic"
        All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
      }else{
        if(All_S12_dat2[i,5]>.90){
          All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qmic"
          All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
        }else{
            if(All_S12_dat2[i,3]>.90){
              All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qmon"
              All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
            }else{
              if(All_S12_dat2[i,7]+All_S12_dat2[i,13]>.90){
                All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qmue"
                All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
              }else{
                if(All_S12_dat2[i,4]>.90){
                  All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qsin"
                  All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
               }else{
                 if(All_S12_dat2[i,12]>.90){
                    All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qlob"
                    All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
                 }else{
                   if(All_S12_dat2[i,8]+All_S12_dat2[i,11]+All_S12_dat2[i,2]>0.90){
                     All_S12_dat2[i,20]<-"Qmac"
                     All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"species"
                   }else{
                     if(All_S12_dat2[i,8]+All_S12_dat2[i,11]+All_S12_dat2[i,2]>0.60|All_S12_dat2[i,12]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,4]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,7]+All_S12_dat2[i,13]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,3]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,5]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,6]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,10]>.60|All_S12_dat2[i,9]>.60){
                       All_S12_dat2[i,21]<-"hybrid90"
                       
                     }
                   }

                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
write.csv(All_S12_dat2, "C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/02_STRUCTURE/S12_hyb.csv",row.names = FALSE)
```
